name: RF5C Delay
description: Ricoh RF5C164 8-bit sign-magnitude PCM stereo ping-pong delay (up to 740 ms) with 4-32.55 kHz clock and random S&H clock jitter.

params.name: Mode
params.explanation: RF5C164 stereo echo routing (Ping-Pong, Dual 1:0.75, Mono, Wide Inverted).

params.name: Time
params.explanation: Delay time: 20..740 ms (clicks 0..720), then 1/16..1/4. synced to pedal BPM.

params.name: Rate
params.explanation: Ricoh RF5C164 PCM clock rate (4..33 kHz; 33 = max 32.55 kHz).

params.name: Bits
params.explanation: 8-bit sign-magnitude PCM grit (0 = clean 16-bit CD-DA, 55 = authentic 8-bit RF5C164, 100 = crunchy 5-bit).

params.name: ClkJit
params.explanation: Random S&H RF5C164 clock jitter & delay-tap drift (0 = crystal-locked, 100 = unstable clock).

params.name: Tone
params.explanation: Sega CD analog output low-pass filter (0 = dark, 100 = bright).

params.name: ON/OFF
params.explanation: LATCH: normal toggle. UNLATCH: momentary while held.
